title: The Voter Identification (Amendment of List of Specified Documents) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make a change to the list of the types of photographic identification that can be used by a person wishing to vote in person at a polling station at UK Parliamentary elections in Northern Ireland. The changes to the UK Parliamentary election rules also apply to elections to the Northern Ireland Assembly by virtue of article 3 of, and Schedule 1 to, the Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) Order 2001 (S.I. 2001/2599).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Springholm, Dumfries and Galloway) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations impose restrictions of an emergency nature on flying in the area specified in the Schedule. They are intended to be of temporary duration and will be revoked as soon as the emergency in question has passed.

title: The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/1158) (“the No. 5 Regulations”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Portmoak, Perth and Kinross) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke the statutory instrument which imposed emergency restrictions on flying in the area specified in the Schedule to that instrument, the emergency in question having passed.

title: The Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft (Specified Information etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify, for the purposes of paragraph 5 of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021, the information that a police officer may require from a person suspected of flying an unmanned aircraft.

title: The Cambourne to Cambridge Order 2026
summary: This Order authorises Cambridgeshire County Council to construct and operate a new guided busway system between Sterling Way in Cambourne and Grange Road in Cambridge and carry out all associated works.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Portmoak, Perth and Kinross) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations impose restrictions of an emergency nature on flying in the area specified in the Schedule. They are intended to be of temporary duration and will be revoked as soon as the emergency in question has passed.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Edinburgh) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations impose restrictions on the flying of unmanned aircraft in the vicinity of Edinburgh, where the gathering of a large number of persons is due to take place for the Torchlight Parade and Hogmanay celebrations. The Civil Aviation Authority and the Department for Transport agree that it is necessary in the public interest to restrict the flying of unmanned aircraft in that area for reasons of public safety and security.

title: The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement for a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement of a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) Order 2025 and The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement of a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) (Amendment) Order 2025 granted an exemption to Doggerbank Offshore Wind Farm Project 1 Projco Limited from the requirement to hold an electricity transmission licence in respect of Dogger Bank A Offshore Wind Farm. Those Orders combined provided for exemption until 18th December 2026. This Order extends the duration of the exemption until 18th April 2027.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (New Year Celebrations, London) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Spring Park, Wiltshire) Regulations 2026
summary: The Secretary of State for Transport has decided that it is necessary in the public interest for reasons of national defence to restrict the flying of unmanned aircraft in the vicinity of Corsham, Wiltshire.

title: The Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend and add to the regulatory regime for certain cryptoasset activities pursuant to powers conferred by the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (c. 8) (“the Act”).

title: The Individual Savings Account (Amendment and Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Individual Savings Accounts Regulations 1998 (“the principal Regulations”) and the Individual Savings Account (Amendment) Regulations 2025, and revoke the Individual Savings Account (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026.

title: The Value Added Tax (Drugs and Medicines) (Health and Welfare) Order 2026
summary: This Order, which comes into force on 10th December 2026, makes amendments to Group 12 of Schedule 8 (“Group 12”) and Group 7 of Schedule 9 (“Group 7”) to the Value Added Tax Act 1994 (“VATA”). Group 12 zero-rates supplies of drugs, medicines and aids for the disabled. Group 7 exempts specified supplies of health and welfare from value added tax (“VAT”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Loch Goil) Regulations 2026
The Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (Addition of Relevant Enactments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations add to the list of “relevant enactments” for the purposes of sections 13 to 17 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (c. 29) (“the Act”). Under section 13 of the Act, the Treasury may make regulations (an “FMI sandbox”) which may modify the effect or application of such relevant enactments for the purpose of testing the efficiency or effectiveness of new technologies or practices in the carrying on of financial markets infrastructure activities. The effect is to include new relevant enactments within the list at section 17(3) of the Act so that these enactments can be modified by future or existing FMI sandboxes.

title: The Surrey Fire and Rescue Authority (Combination Scheme) Order 2026
summary: This Order makes a scheme which combines the areas of the East Surrey and West Surrey Councils (“the Councils”) into a combined area and creates a fire and rescue authority for that area. Under the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004, the Councils become the fire and rescue authorities for their respective areas when Surrey County Council is abolished under the Surrey (Structural Changes) Order 2026 (S.I. 2026/564) on 1st April 2027. For the purposes of this Order, they are treated as though they are already the fire and rescue authority for their respective areas. The Scheme comes into force on 15th December 2026 for transitional purposes, prior to it coming fully into operation on 1st April 2027. The fire and rescue authority for the combined area is to be known as the Surrey Combined Fire and Rescue Authority (“the Authority”). The Scheme provides for the appointment and terms of office of its members, and for meetings of the Authority. The Scheme also provides for the transfer of staff, property, rights and liabilities from the Surrey Fire and Rescue Authority to the Authority. A full regulatory impact assessment has not been prepared for this instrument as no, or no significant, impact on the private, public or voluntary sectors is foreseen.

The Armed Forces (Amendment of Service Courts Rules) Rules 2026
summary: Under section 253A(2) of the Armed Forces Act 2006 (c. 52), inserted by section 6 of the Sentencing Act 2026 (c. 2), the court or commanding officer has a duty to make a statement in open court when passing sentence for a service offence if the court or officer is of the view that the offence involved domestic abuse carried out by the offender.
